title: Ladder
statementMd:
You've got an array, consisting of $*n*$ integers $*a*_{1}, *a*_{2}, ..., *a*_{*n*}$. Also, you've got $*m*$ queries, the $*i*$-th query is described by two integers $*l*_{*i*}, *r*_{*i*}$. Numbers $*l*_{*i*}, *r*_{*i*}$ define a subsegment of the original array, that is, the sequence of numbers $*a*_{*l*_{*i*}}, *a*_{*l*_{*i*} + 1}, *a*_{*l*_{*i*} + 2}, ..., *a*_{*r*_{*i*}}$. For each query you should check whether the corresponding segment is a ladder.

A *ladder* is a sequence of integers $*b*_{1}, *b*_{2}, ..., *b*_{*k*}$, such that it first doesn't decrease, then doesn't increase. In other words, there is such integer $*x*$ $(1 ≤ *x* ≤ *k*)$, that the following inequation fulfills: $*b*_{1} ≤ *b*_{2} ≤ ... ≤ *b*_{*x*} ≥ *b*_{*x* + 1} ≥ *b*_{*x* + 2}... ≥ *b*_{*k*}$. Note that the non-decreasing and the non-increasing sequences are also considered ladders.

## Input

The first line contains two integers $*n*$ and $*m*$ $(1 ≤ *n*, *m* ≤ 10^{5})$ — the number of array elements and the number of queries. The second line contains the sequence of integers $*a*_{1}, *a*_{2}, ..., *a*_{*n*}$ $(1 ≤ *a*_{*i*} ≤ 10^{9}$), where number $*a*_{*i*}$ stands for the $*i*$-th array element.

The following $*m*$ lines contain the description of the queries. The $*i*$-th line contains the description of the $*i*$-th query, consisting of two integers $*l*_{*i*}$, $*r*_{*i*}$ $(1 ≤ *l*_{*i*} ≤ *r*_{*i*} ≤ *n*)$ — the boundaries of the subsegment of the initial array.

The numbers in the lines are separated by single spaces.

## Output

Print $*m*$ lines, in the $*i*$-th line print word "`Yes`" (without the quotes), if the subsegment that corresponds to the $*i*$-th query is the ladder, or word "`No`" (without the quotes) otherwise.
statementZhMd:
你有一个由 $*n*$ 个整数组成的数组 $*a*_{1}, *a*_{2}, ..., *a*_{*n*}$。此外，你还有 $*m*$ 个查询，第 $*i*$ 个查询由两个整数 $*l*_{*i*}, *r*_{*i*}$ 描述。整数 $*l*_{*i*}, *r*_{*i*}$ 定义了原数组的一个子段，即数字序列 $*a*_{*l*_{*i*}}, *a*_{*l*_{*i*} + 1}, *a*_{*l*_{*i*} + 2}, ..., *a*_{*r*_{*i*}}$。对于每个查询，你需要判断对应的子段是否为梯子。

如果一个整数序列 $*b*_{1}, *b*_{2}, ..., *b*_{*k*}$ 先不减、后不增，则称其为一条梯子。换句话说，存在一个整数 $*x*$ $(1 ≤ *x* ≤ *k*)$，使得下列不等式成立：$*b*_{1} ≤ *b*_{2} ≤ ... ≤ *b*_{*x*} ≥ *b*_{*x* + 1} ≥ *b*_{*x* + 2}... ≥ *b*_{*k*}$。注意，不减序列和不增序列也被视为梯子。

## 输入

第一行包含两个整数 $*n*$ 和 $*m*$ $(1 ≤ *n*, *m* ≤ 10^{5})$ —— 数组元素的数量和查询的数量。第二行包含由整数 $*a*_{1}, *a*_{2}, ..., *a*_{*n*}$ $(1 ≤ *a*_{*i*} ≤ 10^{9}$) 组成的序列，其中数字 $*a*_{*i*}$ 表示数组中的第 $*i*$ 个元素。

接下来的 $*m*$ 行包含查询的描述。第 $*i*$ 行包含第 $*i*$ 个查询，由两个整数 $*l*_{*i*}, *r*_{*i*}$ $(1 ≤ *l*_{*i*} ≤ *r*_{*i*} ≤ *n*)$ 组成，表示初始数组中子段的边界。

每行中的数字之间由单个空格分隔。

## 输出

输出 $*m*$ 行，第 $*i*$ 行输出单词 "`Yes`"（不含引号），如果第 $*i*$ 个查询对应的子段是梯子；否则输出单词 "`No`"（不含引号）。
